name: Hunyuan3D-2
tagline: High-resolution open-source 3D asset generation system synthesizing detailed geometry and PBR textures from images or text.
real_test_summary: Tested the shape-only and textured 3D generation pipelines locally via Gradio and ComfyUI. Produces clean manifold meshes with sharp surface detail suitable for 3D printing or scenes.
pros: Produces sharper mesh topology and higher-resolution textures than early 3D models
Available in mini and turbo variants that run on 8GB to 12GB VRAM GPUs
Native Gradio UI, Blender add-on, and ComfyUI node support
cons: Full texture synthesis stage requires higher VRAM than shape-only generation
Custom community license has commercial usage thresholds for large enterprises
